## Work with me {#work-with-me}

::: {.work-with-me}
::: {.work-card}
#### <i class="bi bi-people"></i> Research collaboration

For academic studies. You bring the data and the research question; I take on the data side of the paper as a collaborator and co-author:

- cleaning and checking the data
- choosing and running the right statistics
- figures and tables
- writing the methods and results

[Ask about a collaboration](contact.html?topic=collaboration#send-me-a-message){.btn .btn-sm .btn-primary}
:::

::: {.work-card}
#### <i class="bi bi-briefcase"></i> Freelance work

Paid, clearly scoped projects:

- sequencing data analysis: quality control, alignment, variant calling, RNA-seq
- reproducible pipelines (Nextflow) and reports (Quarto)
- statistics for biomedical and clinical studies, including study design and power calculations
- cleaning and structuring messy study data
- training in R, Python or the command line

Send a short description of the project and your timeline.

[Ask about freelance work](contact.html?topic=freelance#send-me-a-message){.btn .btn-sm .btn-primary}
:::
:::

## Send me a message {#send-me-a-message}

::: {.contact-layout}

::: {.contact-main}
Whether it's a role, a collaboration, freelance work, or a question about one of the tutorials, send me a message and I'll get back to you by email.

```{=html}
<!--
  Contact form, delivered by FormSubmit (https://formsubmit.co) to the address in the action URL.
  The script below posts to the /ajax/ endpoint and shows an inline status. Without JavaScript the
  form posts normally and _next brings the visitor back here with ?sent=1.
  The first submission sends an activation email to the inbox; nothing is delivered until it's confirmed.
-->
<form id="contact-form" class="contact-form" action="https://formsubmit.co/devon.lee.allies@gmail.com" method="POST">
  <input type="hidden" name="_subject" value="New message from devonallies.co.za">
  <input type="hidden" name="_template" value="table">
  <input type="hidden" name="_captcha" value="false">
  <input type="hidden" name="_next" value="https://devonallies.co.za/contact.html?sent=1">
  <input type="text" name="_honey" class="hp-field" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off" aria-hidden="true">

  <div class="row g-3">
    <div class="col-sm-6">
      <label for="cf-name" class="form-label">Name</label>
      <input type="text" class="form-control" id="cf-name" name="name" autocomplete="name" required>
    </div>
    <div class="col-sm-6">
      <label for="cf-email" class="form-label">Email</label>
      <input type="email" class="form-control" id="cf-email" name="email" autocomplete="email" required>
    </div>
    <div class="col-12">
      <label for="cf-topic" class="form-label">What's it about?</label>
      <select class="form-select" id="cf-topic" name="topic">
        <option value="A job opportunity">A job opportunity</option>
        <option value="A research collaboration">A research collaboration</option>
        <option value="Freelance work">Freelance work</option>
        <option value="A question about a tutorial">A question about a tutorial</option>
        <option value="Something else">Something else</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="col-12">
      <label for="cf-message" class="form-label">Message</label>
      <textarea class="form-control" id="cf-message" name="message" rows="6" required></textarea>
    </div>
    <div class="col-12">
      <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary"><i class="bi bi-send"></i> Send message</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <p class="form-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
  <p class="form-privacy">Your message is sent to my inbox through <a href="https://formsubmit.co">FormSubmit</a>. I only use your details to reply.</p>
</form>

<script>
(function () {
  const form = document.getElementById("contact-form");
  const status = form.querySelector(".form-status");
  const setStatus = (text, kind) => {
    status.textContent = text;
    status.className = "form-status" + (kind ? " is-" + kind : "");
  };
  const sent = () => {
    form.classList.add("is-sent");
    setStatus("Thank you! Your message has been sent. I'll reply by email soon.", "success");
  };

  // Back from FormSubmit's no-JavaScript fallback
  if (new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("sent") === "1") sent();

  // ?topic=… pre-selects a topic (used by links from other pages and the cards above)
  const topics = { tutorial: "A question about a tutorial", collaboration: "A research collaboration",
                   freelance: "Freelance work", job: "A job opportunity" };
  const topic = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("topic");
  if (topics[topic]) form.topic.value = topics[topic];

  form.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const data = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form));
    if (data._honey) return;   // a bot filled the hidden field
    delete data._next;
    const button = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
    button.disabled = true;
    setStatus("Sending…");
    try {
      const res = await fetch(form.action.replace("formsubmit.co/", "formsubmit.co/ajax/"), {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Accept: "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(data),
      });
      const json = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (res.ok && String(json.success) === "true") { form.reset(); sent(); return; }
      throw new Error(json.message || "HTTP " + res.status);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Contact form error:", err);
      setStatus("Sorry, your message couldn't be sent. Please email me at devon.lee.allies@gmail.com or message me on LinkedIn.", "error");
    } finally {
      button.disabled = false;
    }
  });
})();
</script>
```
:::
